pages.text: $(bold)Dreadsteel$() (Default trait of Dreadsteel)$(br2)Effect: Each swing releases a $(bold)wide blade wave$() that $(bold)ignores armor$() to pierce enemies, applying $(bold)Weakness, Blindness and Wither$() on hit.$(br2)Its piercing, armor-ignoring blade waves make Dreadsteel extremely deadly against heavily armored targets, with Wither draining health over time.
